pyqgis_plugin.name: Fillet & Chamfer for QGIS 3.x (Interactive & Batch)
pyqgis_plugin.description: Interactive Fillet & Chamfer tool for QGIS 3.16-3.44 and Batch Fillet / Chamfer Tool for QGIS 3.16-4.0+.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Provides interactive CAD-like Fillet (corner rounding) and Chamfer (corner beveling) digitizing for QGIS 3.16-3.44, plus an instant Batch Processing panel for selected vector features in both QGIS 3.16-3.44 and QGIS 4.0+.
pyqgis_plugin.tags: cad, editing, fillet, chamfer, geometry, digitizing, curve, batch, qgis4
pyqgis_plugin.change_log: 1.0.0.6: - Redesigned Unfillet / Unchamfer tool with CAD Two-Edge selection interaction. - Added edge snapping, live ray intersection preview, and dynamic HUD step prompts. - Updated translations in 40 languages. 1.0.0.5: - Fixed point type conversion in map canvas preview marker for restore mode. 1.0.0.4: - Added Unfillet / Unchamfer tool (restore sharp corners interactively and in batch). - Analytical line intersection geometry reconstruction for arcs and bevels. - Added 3rd mode in floating on-canvas HUD and batch dock panel. - Updated translations in 40 languages. 1.0.0.3: - Initial release of Fillet & Chamfer Tool. - Interactive CAD digitizing tool with floating on-canvas HUD for QGIS 3.x (3.16-3.44). - Batch Fillet & Chamfer dock panel for selected features in QGIS 3.x and 4.x. - Full CRS adaptation (metric meters and geographic degrees EPSG:4326). - Exact arc discretization by segments count. - Action enablement locked to active layer editing mode. - Localized in 40 languages.
